assets.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: ONE new independent transparent RGBA connection layer for chapter 2 of a traditional Chinese 2.5D peony handscroll: the peony moving from court gardens into private and everyday spring gardens. Subject: a low, wide, gently curving PRIVATE GARDEN WATER BANK with a softly bending low pale-stone footpath, shallow pale-celadon water with sparse delicate ripple strokes, a few small mineral rocks and two restrained small peony shrubs, one sparse willow tip at an outer bank. The shore and walkable footpath are the main content. No full bridge, pavilion, palace, roof, imperial balustrade, statue, human, crowd, boat, sky or distant mountains. Style: refined hand-painted Chinese gongbi and blue-green landscape on silk, gentle warm-gray ink line, pale celadon water, mineral gray/ivory stone, muted spring green and small dusty-pink flowers. Light, relaxed, domestic and poetic rather than imperial; no saturated gold or red. Composition: roughly 3:1 horizontal low strip, slightly elevated oblique handscroll perspective; both curving shore ends and all plants fully visible with natural complete irregular footprint. Place the subject inside the central 75% width with generous actual alpha margins all sides. Water becomes genuinely transparent along broken hand-painted outer edges; no cream/white paper backdrop, rectangular blue water sheet or ground rectangle. Output real transparent-background PNG, preserving fine soft ink edges and intact subject. No lettering, seals, watermark, decorative frame, collage, photographs, 3D render or vector icons.

assets.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: ONE independent transparent 2.5D layer for the second scroll 'flowers entering everyday homes', a quiet spring private garden rather than an imperial courtyard. Subject: a long LOW MIXED GARDEN FLOWER PATH, with a softly bending simple irregular gray-stone path, low earth garden-bed edging, small restrained peony foliage mixed with ordinary tiny spring flowers, a few soft grasses and low flowering twigs. The legible path and planted earth are the structure, with sparse small flowers as accents. No large peony flower heads, people, buildings, whole garden scene, palace, roof, pavilion, bridge, golden or imperial stone railing, wall, tall tree, sky or mountains. Traditional Chinese gongbi and blue-green landscape painting on silk: delicate varied warm-gray ink lines, muted sage/celadon, pale mineral gray stone, warm earth, small dusty pink/cream/lilac blossoms. Warm, graceful, relaxed and lived-in, minimal gold, not saturated. Composition: roughly 3:1 very wide horizontal connection strip, low silhouette, slightly elevated oblique scroll perspective. Both path ends and all roots/plant tips are complete, naturally irregular and gently faded into real alpha; keep everything inside the central 75% of canvas width with generous transparent safety margin on every side. The center should retain a few open pale stones and earth gaps rather than become a dense hedge. No solid rectangular ground/background plate. Output genuine transparent-background PNG; no painted white/cream silk background, no checkerboard pixels, no border, letters, seals, watermark or collage. It must be a finished independently placeable hand-painted layer, not a photograph, 3D render or vector graphic.
